CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_central_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'central_admin')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_outlet_manager(_outlet_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.outlet_staff
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
      AND outlet_id = _outlet_id
      AND staff_role = 'outlet_manager'
      AND status = 'active'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_outlet_staff(_outlet_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.outlet_staff
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
      AND outlet_id = _outlet_id
      AND status = 'active'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_outlet_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT os.outlet_id
      FROM public.outlet_staff os
      WHERE os.user_id = auth.uid()
        AND os.status = 'active'
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN os.staff_role = 'outlet_manager' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, os.id
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
      SELECT p.outlet_id
      FROM public.profiles p
      WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
    )
  )
$function$
